title: Chitubu Pasi Pejecha
intro: Munhoroondo dzeKorani, munhu ane mwoyo murefu mukuru akatarisana nemuedzo waizopwanya mwoyo yakasimba. Zvese zvakabviswa - pfuma, mhuri, nehutano. Asi kubva pakuora mwoyo kwakadzika, munamato wakazvininipisa wakapindurwa nenzira isingatarisirwi. Unogona kuziva mweya uyu une nyaya yekudzorerwa inogara ichidzokororwa kwemakore?
clues: Ndakaedzwa nemuedzo wakaoma zvekuti unoyeukwa kwese kwese.
Ndakarasikirwa nezvose zvaikosha - pfuma yangu, vana vangu, uye hutano hwangu.
Muviri wangu wakanga wakazara nemaronda anorwadza, uye ndairambwa nevanhu vese.
Mukushaya tariro kwangu, ndakadana kuna Allah, ndichiti Satani akandibata nematambudziko nekunditambudza.
Allah vakandipindura vakandiraira kuti ndirove pasi netsoka yangu.
Kubva ipapo chaipo, chitubu chinotonhorera chakavhuvhuta, uye Allah akadzorera mhuri yangu uye akaiwedzera kaviri setsitsi.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
